content:
**Radscorpion Egg Omelette** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A Radscorpion Egg that has been cooked into an omelet. It removes one random addiction while restoring a moderate amount of HP and hunger at the cost of a small dose of rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Radscorpion Egg (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Radscorpion Egg | | Radscorpion Egg Omelette (1) | 

Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after picking up a Radscorpion Egg for the first time.

The in-game spelling is that of British English. "Omelet" is the American English spelling. [1]
